note: Residue mass-basis vs heating-value-basis literature check for the ASEAN model (IRENA 2017a x Smeets 2004 residue factors x 15 GJ/t; wood residues x 9.14 GJ/m3). Compiled 2026-11-08 UTC (2026-11-09 SGT). Read-only web research: WebSearch/WebFetch; PDF bodies that WebFetch saved were text-extracted locally with pypdf (no other downloads). Grades: VERIFIED = original text read; SNIPPET = only a search-engine excerpt seen; NOT_READ = source not reachable (403 / bot check / certificate error), URL or DOI given. Quotes are verbatim (<=15 words); PDF-extraction artefacts such as split words ('ton nes') are normalised. Unit conversions in 'value' fields (kcal/kg x 4.1868e-3 = MJ/kg) are ours. Incident: one attempt to open the Utrecht DSpace PDF of Smeets et al. 2007 in the built-in browser showed a 'Now downloading NWS-E-2006-202.pdf' page; the tab was closed at once and no downloaded file was opened or used. Smeets 2004 / Smeets 2007 / Fischer & Schrattenholzer 2001 could NOT be read, so the Smeets basis is not confirmed from the original.

Same paper (Figure note, p.10): 'REmap 2030 in LHV, most others in higher heating value'.
